summary: MCP server version comes from cli.Version() (a hand-authored accessor over the ledger-owned var version in internal/cli/root.go) instead of a hardcoded literal; the MCP GoReleaser build stamps internal/cli.version like the CLI build does, replacing the dead -X main.version target.
reason: The pre-4.27 library layout keeps one ledger-owned 'var version' in root.go, and the release-ledger guard rejects any added/removed 'var version =' line in root.go, version.go, or cmd/*-pp-mcp/main.go, so the MCP entrypoint cannot declare its own stampable var. The prior inline literal (see scrape-creators-release-ledger-version-alignment) left the MCP advertising a frozen 2026.6.2 while the CLI advanced (upstream cli-printing-press#4042; flagged P1 by Greptile on library PR #1680). Reading the root.go var through an accessor gives both stamping paths (post-merge source stamp and GoReleaser -X) a single live target without adding a guarded var line.
validated_outcome: go build ./... and go vet ./... pass; MCP server advertises the root.go-stamped version (2026.8.1 at patch time) instead of the frozen 2026.6.2; no 'var version =' line added or removed in guard-watched files.
